title: Assertion: Enable High When Valid

traces.name: legal: en high whenever valid is high
violation: valid without en for one cycle
legal: violation-looking values while in reset
violation: long valid burst, en drops at the end
violation: en drops the same cycle valid rises

constraints: Rule: on every rising edge of `clk` where `rst = 0`, if `valid = 1` then `en` must be 1.
Report a violation with a failing `assert property` (or `$error`). Stay silent on legal traces: a false alarm fails that trace.
Sampling happens at the rising edge (standard SVA semantics). `rst` is active high and disables checking.
hints: `assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) valid |-> en) else $error("...");`
`|->` is the overlapping implication: the consequent is checked in the same cycle as the antecedent.
`disable iff (rst)` turns the check off while reset is asserted.
